rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 5 "Read the unread slice": lines 70-72: the header's verb ("Read") promises an examine-the-contents action, matching the literal-action pattern this file's own earlier headers set (chunk 1 "Read your repo" -> embedded read prompt; chunk 4 "Check how full the window is" -> embedded /context prompt). Chunk 5 carries no such action: all three bullets interpret the significance of the unread PERCENTAGE ("the number that matters", "stays real", "a map of the window") and hand off to the next exercise -- nothing on the slide has the student actually look at what's in the unread slice.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Retitle around what the chunk delivers (e.g. a stock-take/recap header), or keep the header and add the missing beat: a prompt or instruction that has the student look at specific unread content.
